charts.title: Essential services share one connected physical system
constraints: Arrows describe dependencies and feedbacks, not modeled flow magnitudes.
No chapter boundary removes a physical or institutional dependency.

charts.title: Current-system evidence scorecard
constraints: Mixed units remain in separate cards and are never summed.
Every value retains the geography, period, evidence state, and canonical chapter that owns it.

charts.title: Three decision areas depend on one another
constraints: Cells state documented dependencies, not causal effect sizes.
Cross-system burdens remain visible when evidence is incomplete.

charts.title: Integrated resilience portfolio architecture
constraints: The architecture is a recommendation, not an optimized national build plan.
Each element retains its chapter-specific evidence and delivery gates.

charts.title: Outcome readiness across reference, recommended, and stress logic
constraints: Qualitative planning logic is not a modeled outcome.
Unavailable cross-system values remain explicit nulls until a versioned integrated model is validated.

charts.title: Implementation and research advance through shared gates
constraints: Phases describe sequence and review gates, not promised completion dates.
No phase may claim quantified outcomes while its required data or model gate is open.
